CustomField.description: Set by the upgrade or downgrade listener after it changes the matched membership's product. With the Membership lookup, tells the business process listener that the product-change step is complete, so it sets the submission to Imported instead of changing the product again. See Architecture.md M3-M5.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked once an upgrade or downgrade from this submission has been applied to the membership.
CustomField.label: Membership Product Changed
